nodes.description: IERC20L reference to the QANX token contract (0xAAA7...) used for locked transfers.
IERC20 reference to the USDT token contract used to receive the purchase price.
Mapping(address=>Offer) holding the sale offers made to buyers.
Ownable private owner address, controls privileged functions.
Context._msgSender() returns msg.sender.
Context._msgData() returns msg.data.
Ownable.owner() view returns the stored _owner address.
Modifier restricting caller to the contract owner.
Ownable function that sets _owner to the zero address.
Ownable function transferring ownership to newOwner.
Owner-only function that creates/overwrites an Offer for a buyer with scaling arithmetic.
Owner-only function deleting a buyer's offer from the mapping.
Fallback payable receive() that swaps USDT for locked QANX based on the caller's offer.
Owner-only function transferring the contract's USDT balance to a beneficiary.
msg.sender supplied by the caller, used as buyer identity and owner check.
block.timestamp used for offer expiry arithmetic and claimability check.
External call _usdt.transferFrom(buyer, this, usdtAllowance) in receive().
External calls _qanx.transferFrom(owner,this,amount) and _qanx.transferLocked(buyer,...) in receive().
External call _usdt.transfer(beneficiary, balanceOf(this)) in claimPurchasePrice().
Scaling multiplications _qanxAmount*10**18, _usdtAmount*10**6 and block.timestamp+_claimableHours*3600 in makeOffer().
State-clearing delete offers[key] performed in cancelOffer() and receive().
makeOffer parameter: buyer address used as mapping key.
makeOffer parameter: QANX amount scaled by 10**18.
makeOffer parameter: USDT amount scaled by 10**6.
makeOffer parameter: hours added to block.timestamp for claimability.
makeOffer parameter: hard lock timestamp stored in the offer.
makeOffer parameter: soft lock timestamp stored in the offer.
makeOffer parameter: hop count stored in the offer.
cancelOffer parameter: buyer whose offer is deleted.
claimPurchasePrice parameter: USDT recipient.
transferOwnership parameter: new owner address.
Local copy of _qanx.allowance(owner(),this) checked in receive().
Local copy of _usdt.allowance(buyer,this) checked and transferred in receive().
Constructor local alias of _msgSender() assigned to _owner.

edges.reason: _msgSender() returns msg.sender.
owner() reads the _owner state variable.
Owner check in onlyOwner compares owner() against _msgSender().
onlyOwner modifier uses owner() in its require.
onlyOwner gates transferOwnership().
onlyOwner gates renounceOwnership().
onlyOwner gates makeOffer().
onlyOwner gates cancelOffer().
onlyOwner gates claimPurchasePrice().
transferOwnership writes the _owner state variable.
newOwner parameter flows into transferOwnership state write.
renounceOwnership writes the _owner state variable.
makeOffer writes a struct into the offers mapping.
_toBuyer is used as the offers mapping key in makeOffer.
makeOffer performs token scaling arithmetic on amounts and timestamps.
_qanxAmount is multiplied by 10**18.
_usdtAmount is multiplied by 10**6.
block.timestamp is used to compute claimableHours.
_claimableHours is multiplied by 3600 and added to block.timestamp.
cancelOffer deletes the buyer's offer entry.
_ofBuyer selects the offer deleted in cancelOffer.
receive() requires the offer claimableHours to exceed block.timestamp.
receive() uses _msgSender() as the buyer key for the offers mapping.
receive() reads offer fields (qanxAmount, locks, hops) from the mapping.
receive() performs the external _usdt.transferFrom call before deleting the offer.
receive() performs external QANX transferFrom/transferLocked calls before deleting the offer.
receive() deletes the caller's offer after external calls.
usdtAllowance local value is passed to _usdt.transferFrom.
qanxAllowance local value gates the QANX transfer calls.
USDT token external call can re-enter receive() before the offer is deleted.
QANX token external call can re-enter receive() before the offer is deleted.
claimPurchasePrice performs an external USDT transfer.
claimPurchasePrice reads _usdt balance and address to send funds.
_beneficiary is the destination of the USDT transfer.
makeOffer privilege depends on _msgSender() via onlyOwner.
receive() derives the acting buyer through _msgSender().
receive() interacts with the _qanx token state variable for transfers.
receive() interacts with the _usdt token state variable for transferFrom.

normalization_plan.reason: Buyer parameter only used as the offers mapping key inside makeOffer.
Amount parameter only feeds the 10**18 scaling arithmetic in makeOffer.
Amount parameter only feeds the 10**6 scaling arithmetic in makeOffer.
Hours parameter feeds the timestamp arithmetic in makeOffer.
Lock timestamp parameter is only stored into the Offer struct in makeOffer.
Soft lock parameter is only stored into the Offer struct in makeOffer.
Hop count parameter is only stored into the Offer struct in makeOffer.
Buyer parameter selects the mapping key deleted by cancelOffer.
Recipient parameter is only used by the USDT transfer in claimPurchasePrice.
Owner parameter is only written into _owner by transferOwnership.
Local allowance copy exists solely inside receive() to gate QANX transfers.
Local allowance copy is consumed directly by the _usdt.transferFrom call.
